description: Full augment selection with three readable title slots. Ids are the Arena dictionary ids for these names; the ARAM-era ids this fixture used to assert do not exist in that catalog.

Partial frame whose only readable title (不祥契约) has no Arena dictionary entry, so it resolves to no augment while the title-activity gate still passes. The title is read correctly — only the catalog lookup misses.
Title-like activity that should not match an augment.
Real in-game upgrade card frame: all three candidates keep their augment ids and are level-up cards; the current OCR reliably reads one Lv.2 label and infers upgrade mode for the group.
